title: Unit 6 Consolidation: The Metaphorical Landscape of Hungarian
goal: I can explain spatial, bodily, landscape and historical images in Hungarian.
I can say how an image such as rög or végvár carries a cultural meaning.
I can say how new digital words fit into Hungarian.
